name: jmap-lib
description: Framework-agnostic TypeScript JMAP library with typed protocol methods, convenience clients, and real-server integration tests

scripts.test:dist: npm run build && node --input-type=module -e "import('jmap-lib').then((lib) => { if (typeof lib.JmapClient !== 'function') process.exit(1); })"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
